name: 01_testConnection
description: testConnection sync action with a valid #anthropic_key -> success. The real key is deep-merged from secrets.json at recording time and never written to the committed config.json; replay needs no key.

name: 02_testConnection_invalid_key
description: testConnection sync action with a deliberately invalid key -> Anthropic returns 401, the component raises UserException (exit 1). The dummy key is intentionally not in the real Anthropic key format so it is obviously not a real secret.
